title: SEG Waiver Node
description: Schema for a Waiver node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Created exclusively by the Functional Safety Manager to excuse a FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED test outcome. Sourced from repo G. Append-only and immutable once created.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this waiver. Form: {namespaceBase}/waiver/WAV-{number}.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Annotation with annotationType review on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable waiver identifier. Must match the ID suffix in the id field.

seg:outcomeId.description: IRI reference to the TestOutcome node this waiver excuses.

seg:justification.description: Human-readable explanation of why this test outcome is acceptable despite not passing.

seg:expiry.description: Optional ISO 8601 date after which this waiver is no longer valid.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoG for all Waiver nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo G to the waivers file containing this waiver.
